arms.A: baseline (unchanged path; no PSI, no repair, length floor 0)
arms.AL: A + the same length-stage floor 1.5 s (control: separates the floor from the identified state)
arms.P: PSI39 as frozen in section 39 (PSI_QUERIES 10, PSI_K 2, PSI_SYNTH_SHARE 0.6) + in-place repair
arms.Q: PSI40: structural state identification at the existing path's give-up points or with residual evidence (PSI40_EARLY), budget check (PSI40_MIN_CPU 3 s; at most half of the remaining queries), observation-only necessity check, constructed automata + fold classes, closure / chain / disagreement experiments, counterexample split, at most two synthesis attempts; length-stage floor 1.5 s; in-place repair
arms.QDq: V2 control: Q's SOURCE queries replayed and solved passively (Dq), no formation
arms.Qno: Q with the identified state withheld (same identification and experiments; necessity control)

criteria.CORE_EVIDENCE (per task): Q robustly verifies it with an accepted machine containing a PSI40 state, and none of A, P, AL, Qno robustly verifies it
criteria.PSI40 attribution of V2: of the V2-rule tasks, those whose accepted machine contains a PSI40 state and that Qno does not solve; the claim that PSI40 achieves V2 needs >= 5 of these
criteria.REGRESSION: tasks A robustly verifies and Q does not (reported, never excluded)
criteria.V2 rule (frozen V2 criterion, Q in D's p: >= 5 tasks solved by Q with an accepted machine of m >= 2 state components that QDq does not solve
criteria.V2 verdict: PASS if the V2 rule is met and PSI40 attribution >= 5 with core evidence on those tasks; FAIL if the rule is not met; OPEN otherwise
criteria.V3: not evaluated here (directive: only after sufficient V2 invention evidence)
criteria.cost: real CPU and formation SOURCE queries per arm and per group, reported separately from accuracy
criteria.official: sealed V1 PASS, V2 FAIL (FORMAL) / independent OPEN, V3 FAIL, Q3 OPEN are not changed by this development evaluation; generalization beyond these families stays OPEN
criteria.robust: strict majority of the runs of the arm on the task (the base run alone if not replicated)
criteria.verified_solve: hidden test passed AND every random diagnostic SOURCE input correct (300 inputs, seed 777)

evaluation_set.disclosure: fst16 is the family PSI40 was developed on (new draws, section 39 tasks excluded); rha16 is a developer-authored family written for this evaluation and never used in development; lr_* are new compositions of the independent list-routines lineage

harness: research/q3/budgeted_reach_dev.py (run_arm('D'); Env(spec, 0, budget=60); seed sha256(name) % 1000; fresh process per (arm, task, seed); --semantic; --workers 4; PYTHONHASHSEED=0)
no_post_hoc: PSI40 constants, arms, task lists, seeds and criteria are not changed after this commit; a change after seeing evaluation results turns the set into development data
not_counted: every section 35-39 task (including the section 39 evaluation set, now development data)

runs.QDq: every task Q solves (hidden test) in its base run, replaying that run
runs.replication: every task whose verified outcome differs between any two arms run on it: 2 more same-seed runs and seeds 1, 2 (sha256(name) + 7919 k), for every arm run on that task

status: FROZEN before any agent run on the evaluation set (development only; official sealed verdicts unchanged)
